“Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home. And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.”

HomeView features a beautiful aluminum design with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display connected to a domed speaker base by a stainless steel hinge that provides a smooth tilt for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height. The perfect addition to a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table, HomeView comes in four beautiful colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — each finished with a matching cable.

The elegant design and Liquid Retina display seamlessly blend into any space while remaining clearly visible from across the room. It features adaptive display technologies, including True Tone, that react to changing light throughout the day. Automatic brightness adjusts from 500 nits — bright enough to stay vivid and easy to see even in a sunlit room — down to just 0.3 nits, making it ideal for the nightstand. The HomeView interface intelligently adjusts based on the user’s distance, showing simpler information that’s viewable from across the room and richer detail as they step closer.

A separate wall-mounted HomeView model — available in space gray and silver — offers the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display, powerful set of features, and rich audio. It can be attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, with options for self-installation or professional installation.
A Personalized Experience for Each User in the Home

HomeView recognizes up to six people and delivers a personalized experience for each one. Each user gets their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Personal content stays private from others, while shared photo albums and music can be easily enjoyed by everyone in a household, including guests.
Featuring Siri AI, Powered by Apple Intelligence

HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and advanced Apple silicon. Siri AI is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding and onscreen awareness. With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic and get an answer.

With an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI does more for each person — taking action across apps and surfacing relevant information from Messages and Calendar, playlists on Apple Music, and more by drawing on their personal context. Users have the ability to customize the expressiveness and pace of Siri’s voice on their paired and compatible device so that it’s just right for them. That customization carries over to HomeView, allowing users to go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before. 3 Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, which uses iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so they can pick up the conversation on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro.

With Siri AI built into HomeView, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; ability to have rich, natural conversations; and improved music discovery.
With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world’s most private digital assistant.

Users can personalize HomeView with a collection of playful and informative faces that display information at a glance, taking full advantage of the vibrant Liquid Retina display. The Photos face brings cherished memories to life with stunning Portrait-style depth effects that keep the subject sharp while creating a beautifully blurred foreground and background. By selecting a shared album, users can turn HomeView into a living photo frame that loved ones near and far can help fill. The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. And even Snoopy comes to life on HomeView, with animations that reflect the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments.

HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system. Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio. A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering incredible bass extension. Powered by Apple silicon and real-time system sensors, advanced computational audio continuously optimizes loudness and bass response at any volume. The wall-mounted version delivers rich sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement.

HomeView is the perfect way to enjoy Apple Music, complete with animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, 4 Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps. 5 With Handoff, users can continue listening to a song they were playing in the car or on a walk by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display. By setting up multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy music throughout the entire home with multiroom audio.

HomeView makes it effortless for users to stay in touch and get things done around the house. FaceTime and Center Stage keep everyone framed perfectly, even when participants are moving around the room. 6 Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard. Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house — reaching other HomeView and HomePod speakers, as well as personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. In the kitchen, HomeView is the perfect sous chef, converting recipes from the web into step-by-step instructions with hands-free timer control and help with ingredient tracking, so users can stay focused on what’s cooking.

With Find My, users can check in on loved ones who have shared their locations with them, or track down a misplaced iPhone, AirPods charging case, or personal item with an AirTag attached. And with Live Activities, HomeView surfaces timely, at-a-glance information, like the song that’s currently playing, an active timer, or an incoming Intercom message from another room.

HomeView allows users to securely control their smart home by touch or with just their voice using Siri AI — viewing camera feeds, adjusting the thermostat and lights, locking doors, or closing the blinds. The Home Modular face offers instant access to users’ favorite accessories, while the Home Camera face can livestream up to nine video feeds at once, letting users keep an eye on doorstep deliveries and pets playing in the yard.

With a supported iCloud+ subscription, HomeView works with compatible cameras to deliver intelligent, end-to-end encrypted recognition of people, familiar faces, pets, packages, and vehicles, notifying the household the moment someone arrives at the front door. With video descriptions for HomeKit Secure Video footage, HomeView helps users quickly understand what happened in a video clip without even watching it. 7 Offering added peace of mind, HomeView also detects the sound of smoke or carbon monoxide alarms and alerts users on their iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.

HomeView also works with Apple Home Collection — a new lineup of smart home cameras, thermostats, and a lock designed in collaboration with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric — as well as other Works with Apple Home and Matter accessories. 8 Together, they help users understand what’s happening inside and outside, manage access, keep the home at just the right temperature, and so much more. 9

Like every Apple product, HomeView was built with privacy and security at its core. HomeView and the A18 chip include Secure Exclaves: protected and compartmentalized runtimes used to process camera and microphone data separately from the rest of the system. Isolation features added across many core components of the silicon work in tandem to protect Secure Exclaves and keep them segregated from the rest of the system. Data that is processed and analyzed in Secure Exclaves cannot be accessed by the HomeView software, apps, the user, or Apple. To ensure that personal content stays private to each individual, even when HomeView is shared by the whole household, content in apps like Messages and Calendar is only surfaced when the enrolled user is recognized by their face, and when their paired iPhone or iPad is present and has been recently unlocked. 10

Siri requests on HomeView can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud. When processed in Private Cloud Compute, data is not stored nor made accessible to Apple or anyone else.

HomeView was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. HomeView is made with 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure base and in the enclosure of the wall-mounted model, 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards, and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets. HomeView meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 11 and designed to be recycled.

Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

The products will be available within Schneider Electric's Schneider Home residential portfolio.
Users can adjust the temperature hands-free using Siri on Apple products.
The small metal bezel features a smooth silver finish, blending perfectly in any environment.
Its translucent display gives it a soft matte face with no glare, and proximity awareness makes every interaction effortless and gentle on the eyes in a dark room.
Built-in sensing plus optional Room Sensors allow the system to sense conditions including temperature and humidity, adapting to the unique needs of users' homes.
" The smartest home is one where every part works together, and that's only possible through technology that enables energy intelligence," said Olivier Blum, CEO of Schneider Electric.
All three Power Mounts feature precision magnets to securely hold Apple HomeView against the wall to stay powered.

For a seamless professional installation with no visible wires, the AC Wired Power Mount connects to electrical wiring through a single wall box, and the PoE Wired Power Mount receives power and data through a standard ethernet cable hidden in the wall.

" At Apple, our goal is to deliver great products that make everyday experiences simpler and more enjoyable, with privacy at the core, " said Matthew Costello, Apple's vice president of Hardware Engineering.

Set up, connectivity, and security have never been better, with effortless tap-to-pair NFC functionality even when Smart Thermostat is not powered, allowing set up in seconds by simply bringing an iPhone nearby.

Home energy is becoming more complex, benefiting from different sources of electricity, consuming more power, and operating in a siloed ecosystem across heating and cooling, water heating, EV charging, appliances, and connected devices.

Schneider Home represents a vision for how home energy technologies can work together with seamless orchestration, helping homeowners better understand, manage, and optimize their energy use, without compromising comfort, simplicity, or cost.

For customers who prefer to have their smart home accessories professionally installed, Apple Retail now offers third-party installation from ADT for an additional charge, available in the U.S. starting this fall.
ADT also leverages the nationwide installer network from Qmerit , backed by Schneider Electric.

extraction.body: Apple today unveiled the "HomeView," its long-awaited smart home hub featuring a 7-inch display. The $299 device is available in two versions: One with a speaker base and a second model that mounts on the wall. Pre-orders start today, and it will hit store shelves on November 13. Apple says the HomeView is "designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it." The new smart home hub has a 7-inch Liquid Retina display, and provides entertainment, connection, and smart home management all in one place. Apple says the devices functions are all designed with privacy and security at the core, whether it's playing music, making FaceTime calls, monitoring your home, or controlling hands-free automations with voice control. “Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home. And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.” HomeView can recognize users by their faces, allowing user to securely access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, the new, more capable, and more conversational version of Siri that we have waited for, lo these many years. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device, HomeView can tap into a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more helpful, personalized responses. Table Model HomeView is designed to fit in any space, and it can be placed on a tabletop or be wall-mounted to fit in spaces like an entryway or a hallway. The table model's aluminum design boasts a 7-inch Liquid Retina display and a domed speaker base connected by a stainless steel hinge that allows user to tilt the screen for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height. Apple says the HomeView will fit in on a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table. The new smart home hub is available in four colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — and each color option includes a matching cable. It features adaptive display technologies, including True Tone, to react to changing light during the day. The HomeView's control interface intelligently adjusts based on the user’s distance, showing simple information that’s easily viewable from across the room, while providing more details as the user steps closer. Wall-Mounted Model The wall-mounted model of the HomeView is available in space gray and silver, and boasts the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display, powerful features, and rich audio. It can be attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, and it can be self-installed or you can have a professional come in and perform the installation. A Personalized Experience HomeView has the ability to recognize up to six people, providing a personalized experience for each individual user, including their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Siri AI, Powered by Apple Intelligence HomeView features the long-awaited Siri AI, powered by Apple Intelligence. The new Siri has broader world knowledge, and communicates with the users by being more conversational and having personal context understanding and onscreen awareness. Siri AI can do more for users that have an Apple Intelligence-capable iPhone or iPad, as it can take action across apps, drawing on relevant information from Messages and Calendar, the user's Apple Music playlists, and draw on the user's personal context. On these devices, including the HomeView, users can carry on a conversation with Siri like never before. Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, using iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so the conversation can be picked up on the user's iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro. Even users lacking an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; rich, natural conversations; and better music discovery. HomeView's Customizable Faces The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. Even Snoopy makes an appearance on HomeView (gotta get as much out of that Peanut licensing deal as possible, right?), with animations reflecting the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments. Entertainment and Communication Options HomeView's custom-engineered acoustic system offers an exceptional listening experience, thanks to two custom full-range drivers in the display, providing crisp and clean sounds that fills up the room with Spatial Audio. A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering excellent bass extension. HomeView is powered by Apple silicon and includes real-time system sensors, allowing advanced computational audio that continuously optimizes loudness and bass response at any volume. Even the wall-mounted version delivers rich sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement. Apple Music listeners can enjoy animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps. Handoff allows users to continue enjoying a song they were playing in the car by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display. By having multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy their favorite music throughout their entire home, thanks to multiroom audio. HomeView makes it easy for users to stay in touch, while also getting things done around the house. Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard, while Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house, via other HomeView and HomePod speakers, or even personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.

sources.title: Schneider Electric and Apple introduce new Smart Thermostat for Apple Home Collection and Power Mount for Apple HomeView - Yahoo Finance
passages: 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Schneider Electric, a global energy technology leader, today announced a new Smart Thermostat, co-developed with Apple for Apple Home Collection, and an exclusive Power Mount for the newly announced Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted).
The products will be available within Schneider Electric's Schneider Home residential portfolio.
Users can adjust the temperature hands-free using Siri on Apple products.
The small metal bezel features a smooth silver finish, blending perfectly in any environment.
Its translucent display gives it a soft matte face with no glare, and proximity awareness makes every interaction effortless and gentle on the eyes in a dark room.
Built-in sensing plus optional Room Sensors allow the system to sense conditions including temperature and humidity, adapting to the unique needs of users' homes.
" The smartest home is one where every part works together, and that's only possible through technology that enables energy intelligence," said Olivier Blum, CEO of Schneider Electric.
All three Power Mounts feature precision magnets to securely hold Apple HomeView against the wall to stay powered.

For a seamless professional installation with no visible wires, the AC Wired Power Mount connects to electrical wiring through a single wall box, and the PoE Wired Power Mount receives power and data through a standard ethernet cable hidden in the wall.

" At Apple, our goal is to deliver great products that make everyday experiences simpler and more enjoyable, with privacy at the core, " said Matthew Costello, Apple's vice president of Hardware Engineering.

Set up, connectivity, and security have never been better, with effortless tap-to-pair NFC functionality even when Smart Thermostat is not powered, allowing set up in seconds by simply bringing an iPhone nearby.

Home energy is becoming more complex, benefiting from different sources of electricity, consuming more power, and operating in a siloed ecosystem across heating and cooling, water heating, EV charging, appliances, and connected devices.

Schneider Home brings energy intelligence to the home, with solutions including the Smart Thermostat, EV chargers, circuit breakers, electrical panels, uninterruptable power supply (UPS) and connected wiring devices.

Schneider Home represents a vision for how home energy technologies can work together with seamless orchestration, helping homeowners better understand, manage, and optimize their energy use, without compromising comfort, simplicity, or cost.

For customers who prefer to have their smart home accessories professionally installed, Apple Retail now offers third-party installation from ADT for an additional charge, available in the U.S. starting this fall.
ADT also leverages the nationwide installer network from Qmerit , backed by Schneider Electric.
Its technologies enable buildings, data centers, factories, infrastructure, and grids to operate as open, interconnected ecosystems, enhancing performance, resilience, and sustainability.
The portfolio includes intelligent devices, software-defined architectures, AI-powered systems, digital services, and expert advisory.
With 160,000 employees and 1 million partners in over 100 countries, Schneider Electric is consistently ranked among the world's most sustainable companies.
Smart Thermostat retails for a suggested MSRP of $199.99; Room Sensor retails for a suggested MSRP of $39.99.

passages: Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage the home

“It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home.

And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.”

With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core.
By setting up multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy music throughout the entire home with multiroom audio.

HomeView also works with Apple Home Collection — a new lineup of smart home cameras, thermostats, and a lock designed in collaboration with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric — as well as other Works with Apple Home and Matter accessories.
8 Together, they help users understand what’s happening inside and outside, manage access, keep the home at just the right temperature, and so much more.
With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic and get an answer.
HomeView was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030.

HomeView is made with 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure base and in the enclosure of the wall-mounted model, 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards, and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.
HomeView meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry.
HomeView and the A18 chip include Secure Exclaves: protected and compartmentalized runtimes used to process camera and microphone data separately from the rest of the system.
Data that is processed and analyzed in Secure Exclaves cannot be accessed by the HomeView software, apps, the user, or Apple.

To ensure that personal content stays private to each individual, even when HomeView is shared by the whole household, content in apps like Messages and Calendar is only surfaced when the enrolled user is recognized by their face, and when their paired iPhone or iPad is present and has been recently unlocked.
Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984.
Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV.
Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system.
Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio.
A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering incredible bass extension.
Siri requests on HomeView can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud.

HomeView allows users to securely control their smart home by touch or with just their voice using Siri AI — viewing camera feeds, adjusting the thermostat and lights, locking doors, or closing the blinds.

extraction.body: Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage the home Apple HomeView is powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI and built with privacy and security at its core CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple HomeView , designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it. With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core. 1 HomeView recognizes users by their faces, adapting so they can access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that’s profoundly more capable and conversational, with broad world knowledge that powers richer music discovery and onscreen awareness. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device, it can also draw on a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more helpful, personalized responses. 2 Designed to fit in any space, HomeView can be placed on a tabletop as the center of the home or wall-mounted to fit in spaces like the entryway or hallway. Pre-orders start today, with availability beginning November 13. “Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home. And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.” HomeView features a beautiful aluminum design with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display connected to a domed speaker base by a stainless steel hinge that provides a smooth tilt for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height. The perfect addition to a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table, HomeView comes in four beautiful colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — each finished with a matching cable. The elegant design and Liquid Retina display seamlessly blend into any space while remaining clearly visible from across the room. It features adaptive display technologies, including True Tone, that react to changing light throughout the day. Automatic brightness adjusts from 500 nits — bright enough to stay vivid and easy to see even in a sunlit room — down to just 0.3 nits, making it ideal for the nightstand. The HomeView interface intelligently adjusts based on the user’s distance, showing simpler information that’s viewable from across the room and richer detail as they step closer. A separate wall-mounted HomeView model — available in space gray and silver — offers the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display, powerful set of features, and rich audio. It can be attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, with options for self-installation or professional installation. A Personalized Experience for Each User in the Home HomeView recognizes up to six people and delivers a personalized experience for each one. Each user gets their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Personal content stays private from others, while shared photo albums and music can be easily enjoyed by everyone in a household, including guests. Featuring Siri AI, Powered by Apple Intelligence HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and advanced Apple silicon. Siri AI is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding and onscreen awareness. With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic and get an answer. With an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI does more for each person — taking action across apps and surfacing relevant information from Messages and Calendar, playlists on Apple Music, and more by drawing on their personal context. Users have the ability to customize the expressiveness and pace of Siri’s voice on their paired and compatible device so that it’s just right for them. That customization carries over to HomeView, allowing users to go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before. 3 Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, which uses iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so they can pick up the conversation on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro. With Siri AI built into HomeView, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; ability to have rich, natural conversations; and improved music discovery. With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world’s most private digital assistant. Users can personalize HomeView with a collection of playful and informative faces that display information at a glance, taking full advantage of the vibrant Liquid Retina display. The Photos face brings cherished memories to life with stunning Portrait-style depth effects that keep the subject sharp while creating a beautifully blurred foreground and background. By selecting a shared album, users can turn HomeView into a living photo frame that loved ones near and far can help fill. The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. And even Snoopy comes to life on HomeView, with animations that reflect the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments. HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system. Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio. A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering incredible bass extension. Powered by Apple silicon and real-time system sensors, advanced computational audio continuously optimizes loudness and bass response at any volume. The wall-mounted version delivers rich sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement. HomeView is the perfect way to enjoy Apple Music, complete with animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, 4 Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps. 5 With Handoff, users can continue listening to a song they were playing in the car or on a walk by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display. By setting up multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy music throughout the entire home with multiroom audio. HomeView makes it effortless for users to stay in touch and get things done around the house. FaceTime and Center Stage keep everyone framed perfectly, even when participants are moving around the room. 6 Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard. Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house — reaching other HomeView and HomePod speakers, as well as personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. In the kitchen, HomeView is the perfect sous chef, converting recipes from the web into step-by-step instructions with hands-free timer control and help with ingredient tracking, so users can stay focused on what’s cooking. With Find My, users can check in on loved ones who have shared their locations with them, or track down a misplaced iPhone, AirPods charging case, or personal item with an AirTag attached. And with Live Activities, HomeView surfaces timely, at-a-glance information, like the song that’s currently playing, an active timer, or an incoming Intercom message from another room. HomeView allows users to securely control their smart home by touch or with just their voice using Siri AI — viewing camera feeds, adjusting the thermostat and lights, locking doors, or closing the blinds. With a supported iCloud+ subscription, HomeView works with compatible cameras to deliver intelligent, end-to-end encrypted recognition of people, familiar faces, pets, packages, and vehicles, notifying the household the moment someone arrives at the front door. With video descriptions for HomeKit Secure Video footage, HomeView helps users quickly understand what happened in a video clip without even watching it. 7 Offering added peace of mind, HomeView also detects the sound of smoke or carbon monoxide alarms and alerts users on their iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. HomeView meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 11 and designed to be recycled. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system.

sources.title: Meet Apple’s New $299 HomeView Smart Home Hub
passages: Apple today unveiled the "HomeView," its long-awaited smart home hub featuring a 7-inch display.
“Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing.

“It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home.

Apple says the devices functions are all designed with privacy and security at the core, whether it's playing music, making FaceTime calls, monitoring your home, or controlling hands-free automations with voice control.
The $299 device is available in two versions: One with a speaker base and a second model that mounts on the wall.

And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.” HomeView can recognize users by their faces, allowing user to securely access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My.

A Personalized Experience HomeView has the ability to recognize up to six people, providing a personalized experience for each individual user, including their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets.

Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, using iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so the conversation can be picked up on the user's iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro.
By having multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy their favorite music throughout their entire home, thanks to multiroom audio.
Apple Music listeners can enjoy animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps.
Handoff allows users to continue enjoying a song they were playing in the car by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display.

extraction.body: Apple today unveiled the "HomeView," its long-awaited smart home hub featuring a 7-inch display. The $299 device is available in two versions: One with a speaker base and a second model that mounts on the wall. Pre-orders start today, and it will hit store shelves on November 13. Apple says the HomeView is "designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it." The new smart home hub has a 7-inch Liquid Retina display, and provides entertainment, connection, and smart home management all in one place. Apple says the devices functions are all designed with privacy and security at the core, whether it's playing music, making FaceTime calls, monitoring your home, or controlling hands-free automations with voice control. “Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home. And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.” HomeView can recognize users by their faces, allowing user to securely access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, the new, more capable, and more conversational version of Siri that we have waited for, lo these many years. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device, HomeView can tap into a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more helpful, personalized responses. Table Model HomeView is designed to fit in any space, and it can be placed on a tabletop or be wall-mounted to fit in spaces like an entryway or a hallway. The table model's aluminum design boasts a 7-inch Liquid Retina display and a domed speaker base connected by a stainless steel hinge that allows user to tilt the screen for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height. Apple says the HomeView will fit in on a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table. The new smart home hub is available in four colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — and each color option includes a matching cable. It features adaptive display technologies, including True Tone, to react to changing light during the day. The HomeView's control interface intelligently adjusts based on the user’s distance, showing simple information that’s easily viewable from across the room, while providing more details as the user steps closer. Wall-Mounted Model The wall-mounted model of the HomeView is available in space gray and silver, and boasts the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display, powerful features, and rich audio. It can be attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, and it can be self-installed or you can have a professional come in and perform the installation. A Personalized Experience HomeView has the ability to recognize up to six people, providing a personalized experience for each individual user, including their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Siri AI, Powered by Apple Intelligence HomeView features the long-awaited Siri AI, powered by Apple Intelligence. The new Siri has broader world knowledge, and communicates with the users by being more conversational and having personal context understanding and onscreen awareness. Siri AI can do more for users that have an Apple Intelligence-capable iPhone or iPad, as it can take action across apps, drawing on relevant information from Messages and Calendar, the user's Apple Music playlists, and draw on the user's personal context. On these devices, including the HomeView, users can carry on a conversation with Siri like never before. Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, using iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so the conversation can be picked up on the user's iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro. Even users lacking an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; rich, natural conversations; and better music discovery. HomeView's Customizable Faces The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. Even Snoopy makes an appearance on HomeView (gotta get as much out of that Peanut licensing deal as possible, right?), with animations reflecting the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments. Entertainment and Communication Options HomeView's custom-engineered acoustic system offers an exceptional listening experience, thanks to two custom full-range drivers in the display, providing crisp and clean sounds that fills up the room with Spatial Audio. A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering excellent bass extension. HomeView is powered by Apple silicon and includes real-time system sensors, allowing advanced computational audio that continuously optimizes loudness and bass response at any volume. Even the wall-mounted version delivers rich sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement. Apple Music listeners can enjoy animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps. Handoff allows users to continue enjoying a song they were playing in the car by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display. By having multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy their favorite music throughout their entire home, thanks to multiroom audio. HomeView makes it easy for users to stay in touch, while also getting things done around the house. Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard, while Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house, via other HomeView and HomePod speakers, or even personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.

passages: Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage the home

“It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home.

And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.”

With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core.
By setting up multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy music throughout the entire home with multiroom audio.

HomeView also works with Apple Home Collection — a new lineup of smart home cameras, thermostats, and a lock designed in collaboration with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric — as well as other Works with Apple Home and Matter accessories.
8 Together, they help users understand what’s happening inside and outside, manage access, keep the home at just the right temperature, and so much more.
With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic and get an answer.
HomeView was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030.

HomeView is made with 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure base and in the enclosure of the wall-mounted model, 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards, and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.
HomeView meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry.
HomeView and the A18 chip include Secure Exclaves: protected and compartmentalized runtimes used to process camera and microphone data separately from the rest of the system.
Data that is processed and analyzed in Secure Exclaves cannot be accessed by the HomeView software, apps, the user, or Apple.

To ensure that personal content stays private to each individual, even when HomeView is shared by the whole household, content in apps like Messages and Calendar is only surfaced when the enrolled user is recognized by their face, and when their paired iPhone or iPad is present and has been recently unlocked.
Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984.
Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV.
Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system.
Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio.
A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering incredible bass extension.
Siri requests on HomeView can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud.

HomeView allows users to securely control their smart home by touch or with just their voice using Siri AI — viewing camera feeds, adjusting the thermostat and lights, locking doors, or closing the blinds.

extraction.body: Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage the home Apple HomeView is powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI and built with privacy and security at its core CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple HomeView , designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it. With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core. 1 HomeView recognizes users by their faces, adapting so they can access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that’s profoundly more capable and conversational, with broad world knowledge that powers richer music discovery and onscreen awareness. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device, it can also draw on a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more helpful, personalized responses. 2 Designed to fit in any space, HomeView can be placed on a tabletop as the center of the home or wall-mounted to fit in spaces like the entryway or hallway. Pre-orders start today, with availability beginning November 13. “Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home. And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.” HomeView features a beautiful aluminum design with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display connected to a domed speaker base by a stainless steel hinge that provides a smooth tilt for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height. The perfect addition to a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table, HomeView comes in four beautiful colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — each finished with a matching cable. The elegant design and Liquid Retina display seamlessly blend into any space while remaining clearly visible from across the room. It features adaptive display technologies, including True Tone, that react to changing light throughout the day. Automatic brightness adjusts from 500 nits — bright enough to stay vivid and easy to see even in a sunlit room — down to just 0.3 nits, making it ideal for the nightstand. The HomeView interface intelligently adjusts based on the user’s distance, showing simpler information that’s viewable from across the room and richer detail as they step closer. A separate wall-mounted HomeView model — available in space gray and silver — offers the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display, powerful set of features, and rich audio. It can be attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, with options for self-installation or professional installation. A Personalized Experience for Each User in the Home HomeView recognizes up to six people and delivers a personalized experience for each one. Each user gets their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Personal content stays private from others, while shared photo albums and music can be easily enjoyed by everyone in a household, including guests. Featuring Siri AI, Powered by Apple Intelligence HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and advanced Apple silicon. Siri AI is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding and onscreen awareness. With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic and get an answer. With an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI does more for each person — taking action across apps and surfacing relevant information from Messages and Calendar, playlists on Apple Music, and more by drawing on their personal context. Users have the ability to customize the expressiveness and pace of Siri’s voice on their paired and compatible device so that it’s just right for them. That customization carries over to HomeView, allowing users to go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before. 3 Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, which uses iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so they can pick up the conversation on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro. With Siri AI built into HomeView, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; ability to have rich, natural conversations; and improved music discovery. With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world’s most private digital assistant. Users can personalize HomeView with a collection of playful and informative faces that display information at a glance, taking full advantage of the vibrant Liquid Retina display. The Photos face brings cherished memories to life with stunning Portrait-style depth effects that keep the subject sharp while creating a beautifully blurred foreground and background. By selecting a shared album, users can turn HomeView into a living photo frame that loved ones near and far can help fill. The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. And even Snoopy comes to life on HomeView, with animations that reflect the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments. HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system. Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio. A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering incredible bass extension. Powered by Apple silicon and real-time system sensors, advanced computational audio continuously optimizes loudness and bass response at any volume. The wall-mounted version delivers rich sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement. HomeView is the perfect way to enjoy Apple Music, complete with animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, 4 Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps. 5 With Handoff, users can continue listening to a song they were playing in the car or on a walk by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display. By setting up multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy music throughout the entire home with multiroom audio. HomeView makes it effortless for users to stay in touch and get things done around the house. FaceTime and Center Stage keep everyone framed perfectly, even when participants are moving around the room. 6 Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard. Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house — reaching other HomeView and HomePod speakers, as well as personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. In the kitchen, HomeView is the perfect sous chef, converting recipes from the web into step-by-step instructions with hands-free timer control and help with ingredient tracking, so users can stay focused on what’s cooking. With Find My, users can check in on loved ones who have shared their locations with them, or track down a misplaced iPhone, AirPods charging case, or personal item with an AirTag attached. passages: Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage the home
Apple HomeView is powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI and built with privacy and security at its core

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple HomeView , designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it. With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core. 1 HomeView recognizes users by their faces, adapting so they can access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that’s profoundly more capable and conversational, with broad world knowledge that powers richer music discovery and onscreen awareness. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device, it can also draw on a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more helpful, personalized responses. 2

Designed to fit in any space, HomeView can be placed on a tabletop as the center of the home or wall-mounted to fit in spaces like the entryway or hallway. Pre-orders start today, with availability beginning November 13.

“Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home. And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.”

HomeView features a beautiful aluminum design with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display connected to a domed speaker base by a stainless steel hinge that provides a smooth tilt for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height. The perfect addition to a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table, HomeView comes in four beautiful colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — each finished with a matching cable.

The elegant design and Liquid Retina display seamlessly blend into any space while remaining clearly visible from across the room. It features adaptive display technologies, including True Tone, that react to changing light throughout the day. Automatic brightness adjusts from 500 nits — bright enough to stay vivid and easy to see even in a sunlit room — down to just 0.3 nits, making it ideal for the nightstand. The HomeView interface intelligently adjusts based on the user’s distance, showing simpler information that’s viewable from across the room and richer detail as they step closer.

A separate wall-mounted HomeView model — available in space gray and silver — offers the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display, powerful set of features, and rich audio. It can be attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, with options for self-installation or professional installation.
A Personalized Experience for Each User in the Home

HomeView recognizes up to six people and delivers a personalized experience for each one. Each user gets their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Personal content stays private from others, while shared photo albums and music can be easily enjoyed by everyone in a household, including guests.
Featuring Siri AI, Powered by Apple Intelligence

HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and advanced Apple silicon. Siri AI is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding and onscreen awareness. With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic and get an answer.

With an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI does more for each person — taking action across apps and surfacing relevant information from Messages and Calendar, playlists on Apple Music, and more by drawing on their personal context. Users have the ability to customize the expressiveness and pace of Siri’s voice on their paired and compatible device so that it’s just right for them. That customization carries over to HomeView, allowing users to go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before. 3 Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, which uses iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so they can pick up the conversation on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro.

With Siri AI built into HomeView, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; ability to have rich, natural conversations; and improved music discovery.
With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world’s most private digital assistant.

Users can personalize HomeView with a collection of playful and informative faces that display information at a glance, taking full advantage of the vibrant Liquid Retina display. The Photos face brings cherished memories to life with stunning Portrait-style depth effects that keep the subject sharp while creating a beautifully blurred foreground and background. By selecting a shared album, users can turn HomeView into a living photo frame that loved ones near and far can help fill. The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. And even Snoopy comes to life on HomeView, with animations that reflect the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments.

HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system. Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio. A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering incredible bass extension. Powered by Apple silicon and real-time system sensors, advanced computational audio continuously optimizes loudness and bass response at any volume. The wall-mounted version delivers rich sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement.

HomeView is the perfect way to enjoy Apple Music, complete with animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, 4 Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps. 5 With Handoff, users can continue listening to a song they were playing in the car or on a walk by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display. By setting up multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy music throughout the entire home with multiroom audio.

HomeView makes it effortless for users to stay in touch and get things done around the house. FaceTime and Center Stage keep everyone framed perfectly, even when participants are moving around the room. 6 Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard. Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house — reaching other HomeView and HomePod speakers, as well as personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. In the kitchen, HomeView is the perfect sous chef, converting recipes from the web into step-by-step instructions with hands-free timer control and help with ingredient tracking, so users can stay focused on what’s cooking.

With Find My, users can check in on loved ones who have shared their locations with them, or track down a misplaced iPhone, AirPods charging case, or personal item with an AirTag attached. And with Live Activities, HomeView surfaces timely, at-a-glance information, like the song that’s currently playing, an active timer, or an incoming Intercom message from another room.

HomeView allows users to securely control their smart home by touch or with just their voice using Siri AI — viewing camera feeds, adjusting the thermostat and lights, locking doors, or closing the blinds. The Home Modular face offers instant access to users’ favorite accessories, while the Home Camera face can livestream up to nine video feeds at once, letting users keep an eye on doorstep deliveries and pets playing in the yard.

With a supported iCloud+ subscription, HomeView works with compatible cameras to deliver intelligent, end-to-end encrypted recognition of people, familiar faces, pets, packages, and vehicles, notifying the household the moment someone arrives at the front door. With video descriptions for HomeKit Secure Video footage, HomeView helps users quickly understand what happened in a video clip without even watching it. 7 Offering added peace of mind, HomeView also detects the sound of smoke or carbon monoxide alarms and alerts users on their iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.

HomeView also works with Apple Home Collection — a new lineup of smart home cameras, thermostats, and a lock designed in collaboration with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric — as well as other Works with Apple Home and Matter accessories. 8 Together, they help users understand what’s happening inside and outside, manage access, keep the home at just the right temperature, and so much more. 9

Like every Apple product, HomeView was built with privacy and security at its core. HomeView and the A18 chip include Secure Exclaves: protected and compartmentalized runtimes used to process camera and microphone data separately from the rest of the system. Isolation features added across many core components of the silicon work in tandem to protect Secure Exclaves and keep them segregated from the rest of the system. Data that is processed and analyzed in Secure Exclaves cannot be accessed by the HomeView software, apps, the user, or Apple. To ensure that personal content stays private to each individual, even when HomeView is shared by the whole household, content in apps like Messages and Calendar is only surfaced when the enrolled user is recognized by their face, and when their paired iPhone or iPad is present and has been recently unlocked. 10

Siri requests on HomeView can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud. When processed in Private Cloud Compute, data is not stored nor made accessible to Apple or anyone else.

HomeView was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. HomeView is made with 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure base and in the enclosure of the wall-mounted model, 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards, and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets. HomeView meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 11 and designed to be recycled.

Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

extraction.headline: Meet Apple’s New $299 HomeView Smart Home Hub
extraction.description: Apple today unveiled the "HomeView," its long-awaited smart home hub featuring a 7-inch display. The $299 device is available in two versions: One with a speaker base and a second model that mounts on the wall.

relevantPassages.text: Apple today unveiled the "HomeView," its long-awaited smart home hub featuring a 7-inch display.
“Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing.

“It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home.

Apple says the devices functions are all designed with privacy and security at the core, whether it's playing music, making FaceTime calls, monitoring your home, or controlling hands-free automations with voice control.
The $299 device is available in two versions: One with a speaker base and a second model that mounts on the wall.

And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.” HomeView can recognize users by their faces, allowing user to securely access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My.

A Personalized Experience HomeView has the ability to recognize up to six people, providing a personalized experience for each individual user, including their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets.

Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, using iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so the conversation can be picked up on the user's iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro.
By having multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy their favorite music throughout their entire home, thanks to multiroom audio.
Apple Music listeners can enjoy animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News, Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps.

Nothing has made a name for itself as an under-the-radar tech brand, but it doesn’t look like it will stay under the radar much longer. The London-based company announced that Charli XCX will be its first global ambassador, with the singer appearing in a campaign highlighting its headphones . In addition to joining Nothing as an ambassador, Charli XCX also signed up as a shareholder, indicating that this partnership isn’t just a one-and-done photoshoot. In a statement, Charli wrote, “When I’m creating, I’m always thinking about how my work will be experienced out in the world and I love how Nothing headphones sound and are designed. Its ethos of prioritising creatives is really something I look for when working with a partner.” The campaign was shot by Charli XCX’s longtime collaborator Aidan Zamiri, and features her in a room “for five days,” highlighting the longevity of the headphones’ battery. While we have to assume she wasn’t locked in a room for a full work week, given how busy she’s been — in addition to soundtracking Wuthering Heights , she’s appearing in four movies this year and just released “ Rock Music ,” the first single for her anticipated post- Brat album — the spot is a convincing sell. The Nothing (a) headphones, Charli XCX’s co-star in the campaign, were released in March of this year, and boast a retro-futuristic design with up to 135 hours of battery life with ANC off. In addition to the playful aesthetic, the headphones feature physical volume and playback controls for a more tactile experience. The Nothing (a) headphones are the sequel to the brand’s flagship over-ears , which we tested last year. Beyond their bold look, Nothing’s earbuds and headphones have great sound quality and features, which is why they’re among our favorite AirPod alternatives and noise-canceling headphones . Writing in his latest Power On newsletter , Gurman says the teams responsible for store layouts are preparing changes to the "Avenues," or the perimeter walls in Apple's newer stores, where accessories like HomePod, Apple TV, AirPods, and Beats are displayed alongside third-party accessories. The work is said to involve rearranging sections of the Avenues and adding accessory bays for upcoming new devices. Apple is already believed to have an upgraded Apple TV and a new HomePod mini coming up. Gurman said in July that both were nearly ready, with faster chips for Siri AI but no major design changes. Rumors indicate an A17 Pro chip or better in the new Apple TV, and an S9-series chip, improved sound, and a red finish for the HomePod mini, the current version of which is now over 2,000 days old. All of that being said, Gurman says the scale of the retail changes suggests prep-work for the launch of its long-awaited home hub with a display (aka the rumored HomePod with Display or "HomePad"). Gurman reported last month that the smart home hub will arrive at some point between October and early next year. It's expected to have a 7-inch square display, and will be sold with either a tabletop base or a wall mount. There's also said to be an all-new operating system built around tvOS with Siri AI powering the device. Code strings uncovered in macOS Tahoe 26.7 last week suggest the home screen will use a Widget Gallery similar to the iPhone's Lock Screen customization options. The code also indicates that the new device's home screen could have many of the same options for icons, widgets, and clock faces, with widgets from a linked iPhone suggested automatically. Apple will need a dedicated space where customers can see how the hub works, what its purpose is, and how it fits into the wider home setup, Gurman reports. extraction.body: Apple appears to be preparing to roll out a new logo for Apple Music, with the redesigned branding now appearing inside the company’s latest software betas. The new Apple Music wordmark has been spotted in iOS 27.2 beta 3 and macOS 27.2 beta 3, providing the clearest indication yet that Apple intends to adopt it across the music streaming service. The design uses a noticeably bolder typeface and lowercase styling, replacing the thinner Apple Music wordmark used previously. The logo itself is not entirely new. Apple first used the design last month when it unveiled Apple Music Hall , its new live music venue at Battersea Power Station in London. At the time, it was unclear whether the branding had been created specifically for the venue. Apple has since used the same design in Apple Music promotional material unrelated to the hall, and its appearance inside iOS and macOS now strongly suggests it is becoming the service’s official wordmark. The change was spotted in the latest beta software by Aaron Perris and highlighted by MacRumors . Apple has not formally announced an Apple Music rebrand or said when the new logo will be adopted everywhere. Its inclusion in iOS 27.2 and macOS 27.2 suggests users could begin seeing the refreshed branding more widely when those software updates are released publicly. sources.title: Is iOS 15 Coming? Apple Music for Artists’ New Icon Reportedly a Preparation for New Software Version
passages: The iOS 15's presence may be speculation or in preparation for the new version of its operating system, as September draws near. iOS 15 Speculations Due to Apple Music for Artists Apple has recently announced and released the "Apple Music for Artists" version of the company's iTunes and in-device music player.
sources.body: The iOS 15's presence may be speculation or in preparation for the new version of its operating system, as September draws near. iOS 15 Speculations Due to Apple Music for Artists Apple has recently announced and released the "Apple Music for Artists" version of the company's iTunes and in-device music player.

extraction.body: Apple has recently announced that it has updated the icon for its Apple Music, which would be intended for artists and song makers, who then could view their engagements and keep track of their statistics online. However, the change in the icon also led to raise speculations that a new software version for the iPhone is coming, and that is the iOS 15. While there are no updates or information regarding the iOS 15 as of this moment, this might be the earliest speculation or suspicion that Apple is already gearing up for the release of their next OS version. However, it would not be released anytime during this moment, especially as it could take up to a year since it last released the iOS 14 in September. Apple is known for observing a release of an update of their devices a year after its initial update has taken place, and this has been apparent with the iPhone 11 to iPhone 12 transition, which was even late by a month. The iOS 15's presence may be speculation or in preparation for the new version of its operating system, as September draws near. iOS 15 Speculations Due to Apple Music for Artists Apple has recently announced and released the "Apple Music for Artists" version of the company's iTunes and in-device music player. Apple Music for Artists LogoWith this new venture by Apple, they have also provided a new icon, which now sports a white background that has accents of red, used for the outline of the music note logo and the box itself. Apple may have used this chance to design a new logo so that people would not be confused between the Apple Music logo and the new venture dedicated to Artists.However, it was also due to this icon that led leakers and speculators to perceive this as the "something new" from Apple that suggests something is brewing up in their development team, concerned for the iOS. One of the indicators of an iOS change is the new look and appearance for logos of the built-in apps from Apple, and this might suggest it. Currently, there is no news regarding the arrival of the iOS 15 anytime soon, nor its features and functions once it officially releases to public beta testers and users for a first-hand look. However, according to Mac Rumors, what it does suggest is how the icons of the iOS 15 would look once it releases for the public in the coming months. The design of the Apple Music for Artists' logo shows that it would use the same looks like the old icons, but it would focus more on "popping up" the outlines of the design, which was a similar case to the iOS 14 transition.
